name: Pokémon All In Version
summary: A gambling-themed ROM hack of Pokémon Emerald. Adds a Game Corner to every town, replaces the ability to catch wild encounters with Pokémon-dispensing gacha machines, adds several new Game Corner games, and allows for various luck-based options to spice up battles, including dice, coin flips, slots, and built-in enemy randomizing.
